title: Wind turbine drivetrain / bearing degradation
symptoms: high vibration high temperature overheating low power output below expected underperformance wind turbine gearbox bearing
causes: Gearbox or main-bearing wear (rising vibration with heat and lost output)
Generator bearing damage or lubrication failure
checks: Pull condition-monitoring (CMS) vibration spectra and look for bearing/gear tones
Check gearbox oil temperature, oil level and particle count
Review SCADA alarms and pitch/yaw events around the same hours
Schedule a borescope/bearing inspection per OEM procedure if the trend persists
safety: Lock-out/tag-out and OEM procedures before any nacelle access; do not climb in high wind.

title: Wind turbine rotor imbalance or blade issue
symptoms: high vibration wind turbine without high temperature rotor imbalance blade icing damage pitch
causes: Blade pitch angle mismatch between blades
Ice or dirt build-up, or blade damage
checks: Compare the three blade pitch angles in SCADA
Inspect blades by drone or camera for ice, cracks or leading-edge erosion
Check tower and foundation bolt torque records
safety: Stop the turbine if vibration trips alarm limits; keep clear of the ice-throw zone.

title: Wind turbine below power curve
symptoms: low power output below expected underperformance wind turbine yaw misalignment pitch curtailment anemometer
causes: Pitch control fault or blade soiling/icing
Faulty anemometer giving a wrong wind reading
checks: Check for curtailment or derate commands in SCADA
Compare nacelle anemometer with a neighbouring turbine or met mast
Verify yaw error and pitch angles
Compare against the turbine's warranted power curve
safety: Confirm curtailment status before treating this as a fault.

title: Solar inverter overheating
symptoms: high temperature overheating solar inverter no generation night standby cooling fan filter
causes: Cooling-fan failure or blocked air filters
Failing power module or loose DC/AC terminal heating up
checks: Inspect fans and filters, and check fan run status
Take a thermal-camera scan of terminals and busbars
Review inverter internal temperature and derating alarms
Check cabinet door seals and ventilation clearance
safety: De-energise and isolate DC and AC sides before opening the cabinet; wear arc-flash PPE.

title: Solar inverter / transformer abnormal vibration
symptoms: high vibration high temperature solar inverter no generation night standby fan bearing loose mounting transformer
causes: Failing cooling-fan bearing running while idle
Transformer or reactor loosening or core noise
checks: Listen and walk down the unit for rattling or fan noise
Check mounting bolts and panel fasteners
Check transformer oil temperature and any gas/pressure alarms
Compare with the neighbouring inverter
safety: Keep clear of energised enclosures; escalate immediately if burning smell, smoke or oil leak is seen.

title: Solar output below irradiance
symptoms: low power output below expected underperformance solar irradiance soiling string tripped combiner derate shading curtailment
causes: Tripped string or combiner box, or open DC isolator
Inverter derating from heat or grid limits
checks: Check inverter status/derating codes and string currents
Compare with neighbouring inverters at the same irradiance
Check curtailment signals
Inspect modules for soiling or shading
safety: DC strings stay live in daylight; use rated tools and PPE.

title: Output above expected (measurement issue)
symptoms: power above expected over reporting irradiance sensor under-reading meter calibration
causes: Irradiance or wind sensor under-reading (dirty or miscalibrated)
checks: Clean and verify the pyranometer or anemometer
Cross-check with a second sensor or nearby asset
Check meter calibration records
safety: Low safety risk; treat as a data-quality issue first.

title: Power reported with no sunlight
symptoms: power at night no irradiance solar sensor offset meter
checks: Check the meter zero offset and CT wiring
Verify the irradiance sensor reading against a neighbour
Check whether auxiliary loads are being logged as generation

title: Sensor flatline / communication loss
symptoms: flatline stuck frozen sensor no variation communication loss
causes: Communication or logger outage that repeats the last value
checks: Check logger and gateway communication status
Inspect sensor wiring and power supply
Compare with a redundant sensor
safety: Low safety risk; the real condition is unknown until the sensor is restored.

title: Missing or impossible data
symptoms: missing data impossible value negative out of range data quality
checks: Check the data ingestion log for the period
Verify sensor units and scaling
Backfill from the SCADA historian

title: Unusual combination of readings (watch item)
symptoms: subtle statistical outlier unusual combination watch trend early warning
causes: Early-stage degradation not yet beyond hard limits
checks: Watch the trend over the next few days
Compare with neighbouring assets
Review recent maintenance or switching logs
